description: This Java class defines an EmptyResult type for the OpenMRS logic result framework, representing an immutable, empty result that throws exceptions on modification attempts.

classes.name: EmptyResult
classes.description: A subclass of Result representing an immutable, empty result set, with methods overridden to throw exceptions on modification attempts and return fixed values for queries like isEmpty() and isNull().

methods.name: add(int, Result)
methods.description: Overrides add with index to throw ImmutableResultException to prevent modification.

methods.name: add(Result)
methods.description: Overrides add to throw ImmutableResultException to prevent modification.

methods.name: addAll(Collection<? extends Result>)
methods.description: Overrides addAll to throw ImmutableResultException to prevent modification.

methods.name: addAll(int, Collection<? extends Result>)
methods.description: Overrides addAll with index to throw ImmutableResultException.

methods.name: isEmpty()
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the result is empty.

methods.name: toBoolean()
methods.description: Returns Boolean.FALSE, representing an empty or false result.

methods.name: isNull()
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the result is null.

methods.name: remove(int)
methods.description: Overrides remove by index to throw ImmutableResultException.

methods.name: remove(Object)
methods.description: Overrides remove by object to throw ImmutableResultException.
